notes: Partition verified: 35 source and 48 target ids each covered once, with one `added` unit.

קְבֻצַת is recast as the finite comparative *As they gather*: the supplied *As* belongs to the adverbial accusative (rule 33) and the supplied subject pronoun stays inside the same rendering, headed on *gather*; marking *As* `added` under rule 55 is named as the competing reading.

Three English *you*s answer to the single אֶתְכֶם whose scope is distributed across the three coordinated verbs, kept as one discontinuous unit (rules 18, 25) rather than marking two `added`; the head choice between the first and last occurrence is named in the note.
Two judgment calls stand recorded in the unit notes: *it* in *to melt it* is `added` (no object morpheme on הַנְתִּיךְ), while *there* in *lay you there* stays inside the verb's unit.
Neither תּוֹךְ nor כּוּר carries an article morpheme, so rule 29's supply clause places one *the* on the construct and one on the rectum.
